original_requirement: Perform an offline-only investigation of why the real Short Planning Boundary 12 terminated as ContractOutputLimitExhaustedError while the PTR9 exact reasoning-only guard did not trigger, without changing or executing production behavior.
closed_world_justification: The task reads one sealed execution, one isolated read-only run database, historical sealed PTR4/PTR7 evidence, and the exact PTR9 source baseline. It writes reports only.
operational_definition: Reconstruct all 12 calls, decompose every exact guard predicate, separate raw/adapter/runtime layers, verify sticky state from source and receipts, compare PTR4 field-by-field, and refuse root-cause closure when the actual guard input shape is absent.
forbidden_narrowing: No inference of raw provider shape from terminal type
No production, BAML, Prompt, Model, Route, Retry, Fallback, Budget, Validator, StoryState, Canon, or READY change
No Short resume or second run
No claim that PTR4 and Boundary 12 share a failure shape without raw topology evidence
